admin_maintenance.title: Maintenance mode
admin_maintenance.intro: When on, new uploads and downloads are paused (existing ones finish); the rest of the app stays usable. The 'postpone update' flow turns this on automatically.
admin_maintenance.toggle_help: Blocks new file transfers with a 503 while letting in-progress ones complete.
admin_maintenance.message_help: Shown to all users in a banner and returned when a transfer is refused. Leave blank for a default message.
admin_maintenance.activity: In progress right now: {up} upload(s), {down} download(s).

maintenance.banner_default: The server is in maintenance mode. New uploads and downloads are paused; in-progress transfers will finish.

admin_backup.title: Backup & restore
admin_backup.intro: Export this instance's configuration to rebuild it after a crash, or import a backup to restore it. Shared files are not included - importing a backup invalidates every active share.
admin_backup.export_help: Choose what to include and how to handle secrets, then download a single backup file.

cat_help.settings_branding: All admin settings, policies, branding (incl. the logo image) and legal pages.
cat_help.oidc_webhooks: Single sign-on providers and outbound webhook subscriptions.
cat_help.groups: Recipient groups and who belongs to them.
cat_help.users: Accounts incl. password hashes, roles and 2FA (TOTP / recovery codes / passkeys).
cat_help.logs: Audit, email, download, login and notification history. Can be large.

secret_help.passphrase: Decrypts secrets and re-encrypts the whole file with your passphrase. Restores on any server.
secret_help.ciphertext: Keeps raw encrypted blobs - only restores if the target reuses the same JWT_SECRET.
secret_help.exclude: Leaves secret values out entirely; re-enter them after import.

admin_backup.passphrase_mismatch: Passphrases must match and be at least {n} characters.
admin_backup.include_env_help: Bundles infrastructure secrets (JWT_SECRET, DB and SMTP credentials, S3 keys) for the operator to restore by hand. Never applied automatically.
admin_backup.plaintext_warning: A passphrase-encrypted backup contains decrypted secrets once opened. Store it somewhere safe and never share the passphrase alongside the file.
admin_backup.import_warning: Importing REPLACES the in-scope configuration, purges users and groups not present in the backup, invalidates ALL active shares (their files are deleted), and logs everyone out. This cannot be undone.
admin_backup.import_passphrase_ph: Passphrase (only if the backup is encrypted)
admin_backup.sum_shares: Active shares to be invalidated (files deleted): {n}
admin_backup.sum_sessions: All users will be signed out, including you.
admin_backup.env_present_help: This backup carries an environment snapshot. It is shown here for you to apply by hand; it is never written automatically.
admin_backup.confirm_body: This replaces configuration, purges unlisted users and groups, invalidates {shares} active share(s) and signs everyone out. This cannot be undone.

admin_settings.intro: Configure runtime settings without editing .env or restarting containers. Sensitive values are encrypted at rest.

sections.general: Small toggles and miscellaneous app settings - start with the home page on/off.
sections.sso: Configure one or more OIDC identity providers (Microsoft Entra, Google, Authentik, Keycloak, …). Users connect their account to a provider for one-click sign-in.
sections.api_tokens: Decide who can mint programmatic API tokens - everyone, employees only, or admins only. Add specific users or groups to an allowlist on top.
sections.public_links: Decide who can create shareable public links to a share - everyone, employees only, or admins only. Add specific users or groups to an allowlist on top.
sections.email: Configure outbound SMTP - host, port, credentials, TLS mode, From address. Send a test email and see the actual error if something's wrong.
sections.twofa: Decide who must enable 2FA - pick any combination of roles (admin / employee / client) and groups. Affected users without TOTP get bounced into the setup flow on every page load until they enrol.
sections.quarantine: When ClamAV flags an upload, optionally fan out a notification (email + in-app bell) to every admin in addition to the uploader.
sections.email_change: Decide how email changes are verified, whether users may change their own email, and what happens to an SSO link when an email changes.
sections.advanced: Tune session, rate-limit, retention, upload and branding values that otherwise live in environment variables. Each falls back to its built-in default; changes apply live, no redeploy.

admin_settings_email_change.title: Email change
admin_settings_email_change.intro: Email is the sign-in identifier. Choose how a change is verified, whether users can change their own address, and what happens to a single sign-on (SSO) link when the address changes.

mode_help.verify_new: Recommended. The email only changes after a link sent to the new address is clicked. The old address keeps working and gets a security notice with a cancel link.
mode_help.verify_both: Strongest. A link is sent to both the old and new address; the change applies only when both are clicked. Note: if the old mailbox is inaccessible, the change is blocked - use an admin change with 'apply immediately' instead.
mode_help.immediate: The address changes at once (admins are trusted). A security notice is still sent to the old address. Relies on the address being typed correctly.

admin_settings_email_change.oidc_label: When the user signs in via SSO

oidc.reset_setpw: Reset SSO + send a set-password link

oidc_help.reset_setpw: Recommended. Disconnect the SSO link and email a set-password link to the new address so an SSO-only user isn't locked out. They can re-link SSO afterwards.
oidc_help.reset_only: Disconnect the SSO link without sending a set-password link. The user needs a known password, or an admin force-reset.
oidc_help.keep: Leave the SSO link untouched. Sign-in keeps working via SSO, but the local email may then differ from the identity provider's.

admin_settings_email_change.self_service_label: Let users change their own email
admin_settings_email_change.self_service_help: When off, only admins can change a user's email (the core capability is always available to admins). When on, users get a 'Change email' option on their Account page, re-authenticated with their password.

admin_advanced.intro: Runtime-tunable knobs. Each shows its built-in default as the placeholder; leave a field at the default (or hit Reset) to fall back to it. Changes apply live - no redeploy. Secrets and infrastructure stay in environment variables.

rate_limit.register: Register / forgot / verify attempts per window

retention.orphan_reclaim_days: Orphaned files from revoked/deleted shares (days, 0 = disable auto-reclaim)

security.hibp_enabled: Check passwords against Have I Been Pwned

error_log.scan_capture_per_min: Max 4xx errors logged per minute (raise for fuller scan capture)

uploads.max_direct_bytes: Files larger than this must use the resumable (TUS) upload path.

downloads.signed_url_ttl_sec: How long the one-time download link the browser uses stays valid. Longer lets a browser resume an interrupted download (it re-requests the same link); shorter shrinks the window if that link ever lands in a proxy log. The desktop client uses a bearer token and is unaffected.

rate_limit.lockout_duration_min: How long an account stays locked after too many failed logins.
rate_limit.login: Login attempts allowed per IP within the window below before requests are rate-limited. (1-1000, default 10.)
rate_limit.register: Attempts per IP within the window for register-from-invite, forgot-password and verify-email. (1-1000, default 3.)
rate_limit.login_window_sec: Sliding window the login/register attempt limits are counted over. (30-86400 sec, default 900.)
rate_limit.lockout_threshold: Consecutive failed logins on one account before it is locked. (1-100, default 5.)

branding.app_name: Shown in the UI header and outgoing notification emails.

auth.access_token_expire_minutes: How long a signed-in session's access token stays valid before the browser silently refreshes it. Shorter is safer; longer means fewer refreshes. (5-1440 min, default 15.)
auth.refresh_token_expire_days: How long a stored session can be refreshed before the user must sign in again. (1-365 days, default 7.)
auth.max_active_sessions_per_user: Cap on concurrent signed-in sessions per user; the oldest is evicted past this. (1-100, default 10.)

retention.refresh_token_days: How long revoked/expired refresh-token rows are kept before hard deletion. (1-3650 days, default 30.)
retention.invite_days: How long unused invites are kept before they are purged. (1-3650 days, default 14.)
retention.audit_log_days: How long audit-log rows are kept. 0 keeps them forever. (0-3650 days, default 365.)
retention.download_log_days: How long download-log rows are kept. 0 keeps them forever. (0-3650 days, default 90.)
retention.email_log_days: How long mail-log rows are kept. 0 keeps them forever. (0-3650 days, default 90.)
retention.inbound_message_days: How long fetched inbound (IMAP) messages are kept. 0 keeps them forever. (0-3650 days, default 90.)
retention.login_attempt_days: How long forensic login-attempt rows are kept. 0 keeps them forever. (0-3650 days, default 30.)
retention.webhook_delivery_days: How long webhook delivery-attempt rows are kept. 0 keeps them forever. (0-3650 days, default 30.)
retention.notification_read_days: How long read in-app notifications are kept before cleanup. 0 disables cleanup. (0-3650 days, default 3.)
retention.quarantine_purge_days: How long quarantined infected file bytes are kept on disk before purging. 0 keeps them. (0-3650 days, default 90.)
retention.orphan_reclaim_days: Grace period before bytes from long-revoked/deleted shares are reclaimed. 0 disables auto-reclaim. (0-3650 days, default 7.)
retention.tus_abandoned_hours: How long an abandoned resumable-upload temp file lingers before the sweeper deletes it. (1-8760 hours, default 24.)
retention.upload_stale_hours: How long a file stuck mid-upload may sit before it is reaped and its empty share failed. (1-720 hours, default 3.)

security.hibp_enabled: Check new passwords against the Have I Been Pwned breach corpus (k-anonymity, no password leaves the server). Fails open if the service is unreachable.

updates.drain_max_wait_min: When an admin postpones a self-update, how long maintenance mode waits for in-flight transfers to finish before applying the update anyway. (1-1440 min, default 30.)

storage.low_threshold_percent: Flag storage low when free space drops below this percent of the volume. 0 disables the percent check. (0-50%, default 5.)
storage.low_threshold_bytes: Also flag storage low when free space drops below this many bytes. 0 disables the byte check. (default 10 GiB.)

anomaly.enabled: Run the heuristic anomaly scan (mass downloads, credential stuffing, multi-network access). Alerts only; never blocks.
anomaly.mass_download_threshold: Alert when one actor downloads at least this many files in an hour. (1-100000, default 100.)
anomaly.multi_network_threshold: Alert when one account is used from at least this many distinct networks in the window. (2-1000, default 4.)
anomaly.login_failure_threshold: Alert when failed logins in an hour reach this count (possible stuffing). (1-100000, default 50.)

public_link.password_rate_limit: Public-link password attempts allowed within the window below before the link is locked. (1-1000, default 10.)
public_link.password_window_sec: Window the public-link password attempts are counted over. (30-86400 sec, default 900.)
public_link.lockout_sec: How long a public link stays locked (all IPs) after too many wrong passwords. (30-86400 sec, default 900.)

admin_general.title: General
admin_general.intro: Small toggles and miscellaneous app settings. New minor settings land here as they're introduced.

admin_twofa_policy.title: Two-factor enforcement
admin_twofa_policy.intro: Choose the roles and groups whose members must enable a TOTP authenticator. Affected users without 2FA are blocked from every page other than the setup wizard until they enrol.
admin_twofa_policy.kv_inheritance_note: No saved policy yet - currently inheriting from the REQUIRE_2FA environment variable. Saving here takes over.
admin_twofa_policy.roles_help: Tick a role to require 2FA for every user with it.
admin_twofa_policy.groups_help: Members of any ticked group must enrol - additive on top of the role list.
admin_twofa_policy.effect_redirect: Affected users are redirected to /account/2fa/forced on every navigation until they finish setup.
admin_twofa_policy.effect_recovery: Recovery codes still bypass login one-time so an enrolled user who loses their authenticator isn't locked out.
admin_twofa_policy.effect_lockout: If you save a policy that applies to you and you don't yet have 2FA, you'll be redirected straight into the QR enrolment wizard - no intermediate lockout. Recovery codes still bypass login one-time if you ever lose your authenticator.

admin_site_url.title: Site URL
admin_site_url.intro: The URL the SPA is served from. Used in every email link, public-link URL, in-app notification deep link, and post-OIDC browser redirect.
admin_site_url.url_help: Include the scheme (https:// recommended). No trailing slash. Saving here takes effect immediately for new emails and notifications.
admin_site_url.env_fallback: Falls back to the APP_URL env var: {url}
admin_site_url.security_note: Two surfaces stay on the env value and are NOT changed by this field: WebAuthn passkey RP origin (changing it silently invalidates every registered passkey) and OIDC redirect URI (IdPs reject mismatches against their pre-registered URI).

admin_site_timezone.title: Site timezone
admin_site_timezone.intro: The IANA timezone every human-facing timestamp is rendered in - admin tables, share lists, public-share pages, and notification emails. Backend storage stays in UTC; this only affects display.
admin_site_timezone.timezone_help: An IANA name like UTC, Europe/Vienna, or America/New_York. Pick from the dropdown or type to filter.
admin_site_timezone.invalid_tz: {tz} is not a recognized IANA timezone.

admin_home_page.title: Home page
admin_home_page.intro: The home page is the welcome screen users see at /. Disable it if you'd rather drop everyone straight into a working surface (Sent / Received / New share).
admin_home_page.toggle_help: When enabled, / shows a welcome card with the user's name, role, and quick links. When disabled, / redirects forward and the page is hidden.
admin_home_page.effect_picker: "Home" disappears from the per-user landing-page picker.
admin_home_page.effect_brand: The file:Heron wordmark in the top header becomes plain text (no link).
admin_home_page.effect_redirect: Anyone hitting / is redirected to their saved landing page or to /share/new.

admin_file_preview.title: File preview
admin_file_preview.intro: Let users preview supported files directly in the browser without downloading them. Applies to both the share view and public links.
admin_file_preview.toggle_help: When off, the Preview buttons disappear and the preview endpoints are disabled - users can only download. Previewing never counts against a share's download limit.
admin_file_preview.types_note: Previewable types: PDF, PNG / JPEG / GIF / WebP images, and plain text. Everything else - including SVG and HTML, for safety - stays download-only.

admin_share_defaults.title: Share defaults
admin_share_defaults.intro: Controls the initial state of the "Notify recipient(s)" checkbox on the new-share form. Senders can still flip it per share.
admin_share_defaults.toggle_label: Notify recipients by default when a new share is created
admin_share_defaults.toggle_help: When on, the checkbox is pre-checked and `share_created` emails fan out to direct recipients and to every active member of any recipient group. When off, the sender opts in per share.

admin_motd.title: Login banner (MOTD)
admin_motd.intro: Optional notice shown on the public login page. Use for planned-maintenance announcements, onboarding info, or anything you want every visitor to see before signing in. Plain text, max 500 characters.
admin_motd.toggle_label: Show the banner on the login page
admin_motd.toggle_help: When off, the banner is hidden regardless of the text below.
admin_motd.text_placeholder: Scheduled maintenance Saturday 14:00 UTC - expect a 5-minute outage.

admin_updates.title: Updates
admin_updates.intro: Where to check for new fileHeron releases. Point this at your own fork's API if you self-publish images. Only admins receive update notifications.
admin_updates.schedule_moved: How often the update check runs is on the
admin_updates.url_help: Pre-filled with the upstream repo. Forks can point this at their own releases endpoint - must return a GitHub-compatible JSON shape (tag_name, html_url, body, published_at).
admin_updates.mode_help: Manual mode disables the cron entirely - you'll only ever see new releases when you press Check now in /admin/system.

admin_email.title: Email / SMTP
admin_email.intro: Outgoing notifications, invites, password resets and shares all flow through this SMTP server. Saving here takes effect immediately - no restart. The password is encrypted at rest.
admin_email.env_only: values come from .env (no DB overrides yet)
admin_email.host_help: Hostname or IP of the SMTP server.
admin_email.helo_help: The hostname fileHeron announces to the SMTP server during HELO/EHLO. Leave blank to use the container's auto-detected name (unpredictable). Set a stable, valid name your server accepts - some strict mail servers reject sends whose HELO name doesn't match (e.g. 554 5.7.1 … Access denied).

tls.starttls_help: Connect plaintext, upgrade to TLS via STARTTLS. Most common; default for port 587.
tls.implicit_help: TLS from the first byte. Used by some legacy SMTPS deployments on port 465.
tls.none_help: No transport encryption. Only sane on localhost / a private MTA on a trusted network.

admin_email.password_help: Stored encrypted at rest. Leave blank to keep the current password unchanged.
admin_email.allow_anonymous_help: Most SMTP servers require a username and password. Only enable this for a trusted localhost or private-network relay that accepts unauthenticated mail.
admin_email.auth_required_note: Enter an SMTP username and password. To send without credentials (trusted relay only), tick "Allow no authentication".
admin_email.test_help: Sends one email synchronously using the values currently filled in above (no need to save first). The actual SMTP error is shown inline if it fails.

admin_imap.title: Inbound mail (IMAP)
admin_imap.intro: Fetch messages from the configured mailbox so replies, bounces and auto-replies show up in the in-app Inbox. Off by default.
admin_imap.enable_help: When off, nothing is fetched and the Inbox stays empty.
admin_imap.use_smtp_help: Reuse the username and password you already set for sending email. Just confirm the IMAP host below.
admin_imap.using_login_unset: (set up SMTP first under Email / SMTP)
admin_imap.password_set_help: A password is saved. Leave blank to keep it, or type a new one to replace it.
admin_imap.schedule_moved: Polling cadence and enable/disable are on the
admin_imap.action_mark_read_help: Flag the message \Seen on the server but keep it.
admin_imap.action_untouched_help: Don't change anything on the server; duplicates are still skipped.
admin_imap.action_move_help: Copy to a subfolder and remove from the inbox after ingest.
admin_imap.action_delete_help: Permanently remove the message from the server after ingest.

admin_inbox.title: Inbox
admin_inbox.intro: Messages fetched from the configured mailbox - replies, bounces and auto-replies.
admin_inbox.delete_confirm: Delete this message and its attachments? This can't be undone.

admin_email_templates.title: Email templates
admin_email_templates.intro: Customise the wording of any email file:Heron sends, per language. Built-in defaults are used until you save a custom version; use placeholders like [RECIPIENT] for dynamic values.

template.email_change_verify_old: Email change - approve from old address

admin_email_templates.placeholders_help: Click a placeholder to insert it at the cursor. They're replaced with real values when the email is sent.
admin_email_templates.discard_confirm: Discard your unsaved changes to this template?
admin_email_templates.leave_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
admin_email_templates.reset_confirm: Discard the custom version and restore the built-in default? This can't be undone.

admin_share_approval.title: Share approval
admin_share_approval.intro: Require a second pair of eyes before shares go out. When enabled, a new share waits in 'pending approval' until a designated approver approves or rejects it.
admin_share_approval.enable_help: When off, shares go live immediately as before.

mode.admins_only_help: Only administrators can approve or reject shares.
mode.employees_admins_help: Any employee or admin can approve or reject shares.

admin_share_approval.allowlist_help: Optionally add specific users or groups as approvers on top of the base set above.
admin_share_approval.users_placeholder: Search users by name or email…
admin_share_approval.exempt_help: When on, a share created by someone who can approve goes live immediately (no self-approval, no deadlock).
admin_share_approval.review_help: When on, approvers can preview or download a pending share's files to inspect them before deciding.

admin_public_link_policy.title: Public link policy
admin_public_link_policy.intro: Public links let recipients without a fileHeron account download a share via a token URL. Pick who's allowed to create them. Admins can always create links regardless of mode.

mode.everyone_help: Any signed-in user can create public links.
mode.admins_only_help: Only admins can create public links.

admin_public_link_policy.allowlist_help: Users and groups added here can always create public links, regardless of the base policy.

admin_api_tokens.create_heading: Generate a token on behalf of a user
admin_api_tokens.create_help: The plaintext appears once on this page. Copy it and forward to the user via a secure channel (password manager / encrypted DM).
admin_api_tokens.no_user_selected: Select a user from the suggestions first.
admin_api_tokens.plaintext_warning: Copy this now - it will not be shown again. Forward to the user via your password / secrets manager.
admin_api_tokens.search_placeholder: Search by owner name or email…
admin_api_tokens.empty: No API tokens match the current filters.
admin_api_tokens.revoke_confirm: Permanently revoke this token? This cannot be undone - the user will need a brand-new token to keep automating.

admin_token_policy.title: API token policy
admin_token_policy.intro: API tokens grant programmatic access - pick who's allowed to create them. Admins can always create tokens regardless of the mode (operator escape hatch).

mode.everyone_help: Any signed-in user can create tokens.

admin_token_policy.allowlist_help: Users and groups added here can always mint tokens, regardless of the base policy.

admin_sso_list.title: SSO
admin_sso_list.intro: Run multiple OIDC identity providers concurrently. Users can connect their fileHeron account to one of them; new users sign in once with their password and click Connect.
admin_sso_list.empty_body: Add an OIDC provider to let users sign in with their identity provider.

admin_sso_edit.name: Display name
admin_sso_edit.name_help: Shown to users on the login page button.
admin_sso_edit.issuer_url_help: We append /.well-known/openid-configuration to discover the endpoints.
admin_sso_edit.client_secret_help: Stored Fernet-encrypted in the database. Leave blank to keep the current secret unchanged. Empty string clears it.
admin_sso_edit.secret_set_placeholder: (secret already set - leave blank to keep)
admin_sso_edit.secret_required_on_create: Client secret is required when creating a new provider.
admin_sso_edit.redirect_uri_help: Only set this if your IdP requires a specific redirect URI different from the default.
admin_sso_edit.delete_confirm: Delete this SSO provider? Users currently linked to it will need to be unlinked first.

account_oidc.section_help: Connect your fileHeron account to an identity provider. Once connected you can sign in with one click - no password.
account_oidc.no_providers: No SSO providers are configured yet.
account_oidc.other_linked: You're linked to another provider - disconnect first to switch.
account_oidc.disconnect_confirm: Disconnect from this SSO provider? You'll need to sign in with your password until you reconnect.

webauthn.title: Passkeys & security keys
webauthn.intro: Register a passkey (Touch ID, Windows Hello, or a USB security key) as a second factor. You can register multiple - your laptop's built-in authenticator and a USB key as a backup, for example.
webauthn.unsupported: Your browser doesn't support passkeys. Try a recent Chrome, Safari, Firefox, or Edge.
webauthn.remove_confirm: Remove this passkey? You won't be able to use it to sign in anymore.

headline.session_evicted: An older session was signed out - you reached your {cap}-session limit.

notif_prefs.title: Notifications
notif_prefs.intro: Choose how you'd like to be notified for each event. "Both" means email and the bell.

admin_branding.title: Branding & legal
admin_branding.intro: Upload a logo, choose where it appears, and maintain your imprint and privacy pages.

logo.title: Logo
logo.help: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 2 MB. It shows next to the app name on the surfaces you enable below.
logo.invalid_type: Logo must be a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.
logo.too_large: Logo must be 2 MB or smaller.

surfaces.title: Show the logo on
surfaces.help: Pick where the logo appears alongside the name.

link.label: Logo link (optional)
link.help: When set, clicking the logo opens this URL in a new tab.

legal.title: Legal pages
legal.help: When enabled, a footer link appears on every page. Content is shown in the viewer's language, falling back to the other.

legal.not_available: This page has not been published.

manage_notifications.title: Manage subscriptions
manage_notifications.invalid_title: This link is no longer valid
manage_notifications.intro: Choose how you'd like to be notified for each event. Changes are saved instantly.
manage_notifications.intro_named: Notification settings for {name}. Changes are saved instantly.

errors.generic: This manage link is invalid or has expired. Sign in to change your notification settings.
errors.INVALID_MANAGE_TOKEN: This manage link is invalid. Sign in to change your notification settings.
errors.MANAGE_TOKEN_EXPIRED: This manage link has expired. Open a more recent email, or sign in to change your settings.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please wait a moment and try again.

admin_users.empty: No users match the current filters.
admin_users.invite_email_help: We'll send a 24h single-use invite link.
admin_users.invite_email_help_direct: No email is sent - the account is created immediately.
admin_users.invite_display_name_help: How they'll be addressed in the invite email.
admin_users.invite_groups_help: Memberships are applied when the invitee accepts the invite.
admin_users.invite_create_direct: Create the account now (skip the invite email)
admin_users.invite_password_help: At least 12 characters. Share it with the user securely - they can change it later under Account.
admin_users.user_created: {email} created - they can sign in now.

invites.heading: Pending invites
invites.help: Users who were invited but haven't yet activated their account.

toast.activated: Account activated. They can sign in immediately.

activate.title: Activate account directly
activate.body: Create a fully active account for {email} with role {role}, bypassing the invitee's password-set step. They can sign in via SSO immediately. The invite link will no longer work.
activate.display_name_help: Defaults to the email's local part. Edit if you'd prefer something else; the user can change it later.

delete.title: Delete invite
delete.body: Delete the invite for {email}? The invite link will stop working and the row will be removed from the list. The audit log keeps a record of the deletion.

admin_user_detail.quota_help: Total upload bytes allowed for this user. Leave blank or 0 for unlimited.
admin_user_detail.force_reset_confirm: Generate a one-time reset token? The current password keeps working until the user clicks the link.
admin_user_detail.reset_warning: Share this token via a secure out-of-band channel. The link expires in 1 hour.
admin_user_detail.change_email_help: Follows the configured verification mode. If the user signs in via SSO, that link is reset per policy. A security notice goes to the old address.
admin_user_detail.change_email_confirm: Change this user's sign-in email? Depending on policy they may need to confirm via a link, and an SSO link may be reset. A security notice is sent to the old address.
admin_user_detail.change_email_pending: A confirmation link was sent. The change applies once it's confirmed.
admin_user_detail.change_email_oidc_reset: SSO link was reset; a set-password link was sent to the new address.
admin_user_detail.change_email_link_help: SMTP may be unconfigured - share this link with the user out-of-band. It expires in 24 hours.
admin_user_detail.erase_help: Right-to-erasure permanently anonymizes this user and hard-deletes every file they uploaded. The action cannot be undone.
admin_user_detail.erase_step1: This will hard-delete every file this user uploaded. The user row is anonymized to [erased]. The action is irreversible.
admin_user_detail.erase_step2: Final confirmation. Click once more to erase.
admin_user_detail.sessions_help: Devices currently signed in as this user, oldest activity first. Revoke a single device or all of them.
admin_user_detail.sessions_revoke_all_confirm: Revoke every active session for this user? They will be signed out on every device.
admin_user_detail.files_help: Files this user currently has stored (counts toward their storage). Delete frees the bytes immediately.
admin_user_detail.files_delete_confirm: Permanently delete “{name}” from disk and free this user's quota? This cannot be undone.
admin_user_detail.emails_help: The most recent emails file:Heron sent to this user.
admin_user_detail.emails_empty: No emails sent to this user.

admin_mail.intro: Every email file:Heron sends is recorded here with its delivery outcome. One-time auth links (password reset, invite, verify) are redacted at rest.

detail.resend_disabled: This email can't be resent - its one-time auth link was redacted at rest (or it was a test/dev entry).

admin_webhooks.title: Webhooks
admin_webhooks.intro: Send a signed HTTP POST to an external URL when chosen events happen (a share is created, a file is downloaded, a quarantine, an ops alert). Point one at a Slack/Teams incoming-webhook URL, an automation tool, or your own collector.
admin_webhooks.name: Name
admin_webhooks.create_incomplete: Enter a name, a URL, and at least one event.
admin_webhooks.secret_warning: Copy this secret now. It's used to verify the X-Webhook-Signature header and is never shown again.
admin_webhooks.delete_confirm: Delete the webhook "{name}"? Events will stop being delivered to it.

admin_analytics.title: Analytics
admin_analytics.no_storage_yet: No storage snapshots yet - the nightly job records the first one tonight (or run it from System).

account.title: Account
account.email_change_help: Changing your email needs your current password. You'll receive a link to confirm the new address; your email only changes once you click it. If you sign in via SSO, that link may be reset and you'll set a password.
account.email_change_unchanged: Enter an address different from your current one.
account.email_change_pending: Check your new address for a confirmation link.
account.language_help: Used for emails sent to you and the UI language.
account.display_name_help: Shown on shares and emails. 1-120 characters.
account.session_revoke_others_confirm: Sign out every other session? This device stays signed in, and all other browsers will need to log in again. Note: this does NOT revoke API tokens - programmatic clients (like a token-based desktop app) keep working until you revoke their token under "Connected API clients" below.
account.api_clients_help: Programmatic clients (e.g. the desktop app) sign in with a long-lived API token, not a browser session - signing out other sessions does NOT disconnect them.

landing.label: Default landing page
landing.help: Where you land after logging in. Pick "System default" to follow whatever the admin has chosen for everyone.

admin_nav.title: Admin sidebar
admin_nav.label: Collapse behaviour
admin_nav.help: How the admin sidebar's category groups collapse. Accordion keeps one group open at a time; Manual lets you open several independently; Always expanded opens them all.

account.change_password_help: After changing, you'll need to sign in again on every device.

twofa.title: Two-factor authentication
twofa.intro: Use an authenticator app - 1Password, Authy, Bitwarden, Google Authenticator - to scan the QR below.
twofa.forced_banner: Your administrator requires two-factor authentication for your account. Scan the code below to finish setup and continue.
twofa.verify_help: Enter the six-digit code your app shows now.
twofa.saved_codes_intro: Each code works once. Use them if you lose access to your authenticator. Store them somewhere safe - we won't show them again.
twofa.active_intro: You'll need a code from your authenticator app on every sign-in.
twofa.disable_intro: Removing two-factor weakens your account. You'll need your password and a current code (or one recovery code) to confirm.

dropzone.hint: Up to 30 GB per file. Resume picks up where the connection drops.

recipient.label: Recipients
recipient.help_phase4: Search for people by name or email. Pick groups for shared inboxes.

expiry.label: Expires
expiry.in_past: already past - pick a future time
expiry.never_help: This share will not expire automatically. Revoke it manually when you're done.

file_preview.too_large: This file is too large to preview - download it instead.

actions.delete_confirm: Delete this file? This cannot be undone.

files.av_unscanned_hint: This file is larger than the virus scanner can process, so it was never scanned. Open it only if you trust the sender.

api_tokens.title: API tokens
api_tokens.intro: Tokens authorize programmatic uploads via the API or TUS clients. Create one per script or device.
api_tokens.sessions_note: These are separate from your browser/app sessions: signing out other sessions does not revoke them. Revoke a token here to disconnect its client (e.g. the desktop app) immediately.
api_tokens.plaintext_warning: Copy this token now - it won't be shown again. Store it where the calling script can read it.
api_tokens.expiry_help: Pick when the token should stop working, or leave "Never" for a token that never expires.
api_tokens.revoke_confirm: Revoke this token? Any script using it will stop working immediately.
api_tokens.disabled_by_admin: Your administrator has restricted API token creation. Ask an admin if you need a token for automation.
api_tokens.scope_full_help: the token can do everything you can.
api_tokens.scope_limited_help: pick exactly what this token may do; everything else is refused.

approvals.title: Pending approvals
approvals.intro: Shares waiting for your approval before their recipients can access them.
approvals.empty: Nothing is waiting for your approval.
approvals.decide_help: Review the files and recipients, then approve to release the share or reject it back to the sender.
approvals.discard_confirm: Discard this share? Its recipients will never see it.
approvals.pending_owner_banner: This share is awaiting approval. Recipients can't see it until an approver releases it.

intro.outbound: Send files to a client or colleague. They'll get an email with a link.
intro.inbound: Send files to the company. Everyone on the team can see your submission.

share_create.message_placeholder: Optional - a note for the recipient.
share_create.to_company: This goes to the company - everyone on the team can see it. You don't pick recipients.
share_create.recipients_or_public_link_hint: …or skip recipients and attach a public link below.
share_create.notify_recipients_help: Send a `share_created` email + in-app notification to every direct recipient and to every active member of any recipient group. Uncheck to keep this share quiet.
share_create.download_limit_help: Maximum total downloads across all recipients. Leave blank for unlimited. You can change this later.
share_create.toast_partial: {n} file(s) failed to upload. Retry below.

public_link.toggle_label: Also create a public download link

public_link.password_help: Anyone with the link will need this password to unlock the share.
public_link.download_limit_help: Maximum number of successful downloads. Leave blank for unlimited.
public_link.result_warning: Copy this URL now - it won't be shown again. Send it to the recipient via your usual channel.

share_detail.add_files_notify: Also notify recipients of the new files

public_link.intro: Generate a URL anyone can use to download this share's files. Optionally protect with a password and limit how many times it can be used.
public_link.url_legacy_hint: URL not stored - this link was created before the viewable-URL feature shipped. Revoke and re-create to get a viewable URL.
public_link.url_lost: The full URL was shown only when the link was created - keep it somewhere safe. Revoke and re-create if you've lost it.
public_link.revoke_confirm: Revoke this public link? Anyone with the URL will lose access immediately.
public_link.url_warning: Copy the URL now. It will not be shown again.
public_link.password_help: Recipients will need to enter this before downloading.
public_link.limit_help: After this many downloads, the link auto-revokes.
public_link.notify_help: Get notified when someone downloads via this link.

public_share.password_help: The sender shared a password to access these files.

admin_group_detail.delete_confirm: Delete this group? This cannot be undone.

toast.all_failed: Could not expire any of the selected shares.

admin_sessions.intro: Every signed-in session across all users. A session rotates on use, so “Last active” reflects the most recent activity - sort by it ascending to spot stale or forgotten devices.
admin_sessions.search_placeholder: Search user name, email or IP…
admin_sessions.empty: No sessions match the current filters.
admin_sessions.revoke_confirm: Revoke this session for {who}? The device will be signed out on its next request.
admin_sessions.revoke_all_confirm: Revoke every active session for {who}? They will be signed out on all devices.

admin_file_history.intro: Every file ever uploaded - including expired and deleted - joined with parent share metadata, uploader, and download stats.
admin_file_history.search_placeholder: Search filename, uploader name or email…
admin_file_history.reclaim_confirm: Permanently delete the bytes of “{name}” and free the uploader's quota? The share is already revoked/deleted, so this only removes dead storage.
admin_file_history.delete_confirm: Permanently delete “{name}” from disk and free the uploader's quota? If it is the last file in its share, the share is revoked. This cannot be undone.
admin_file_history.empty: No files match the current filters.

admin_quarantine.intro: Files ClamAV flagged as infected. The bytes are kept on disk under ./data/quarantine/ so you can download them for forensic review, release them back to the owner if you're confident the verdict was a false positive, or purge them once you're done.
admin_quarantine.empty: Nothing in quarantine. Either nothing has been flagged or everything was already released or purged.
admin_quarantine.search_placeholder: Search filename, uploader name or email…

confirm.release_help: Marks the file clean and (when ClamAV was the only revoke reason) reactivates the share. The bytes move from quarantine back to active storage. The uploader's quota is re-reserved.
confirm.purge_help: Deletes the quarantined bytes from disk. The file row stays at state=infected as the historical marker. Irreversible.
confirm.reason_placeholder: Why are you taking this action? Goes into the audit log.

toast.released: File released back to the owner.

admin_settings_quarantine.title: Quarantine alerts
admin_settings_quarantine.intro: When ClamAV detects an infected upload, the uploader is always notified. This toggle additionally fans out a notification (email + in-app bell) to every admin.
admin_settings_quarantine.toggle_label: Notify all admins when a virus is detected
admin_settings_quarantine.toggle_help: Each admin gets an email + an in-app bell ring per detection. An admin can mute themselves from /account → Notifications by switching the "file_quarantined" channel to "off" (default is "both" - email + in-app).

admin_error_alerts.title: Errors & alerts
admin_error_alerts.intro: Keep a browsable log of server errors and, optionally, email admins about them. Logging and emailing are independent: the log records every captured error, while emails are deduplicated and capped so a looping error can't flood your inbox. Emails carry context only - no stack trace.
admin_error_alerts.log_enabled_help: Persist every server error (HTTP 5xx) and failed scheduled task to a browsable, filterable log - independent of whether emails are sent.
admin_error_alerts.capture_4xx_help: By default only 5xx and cron failures are logged. Turn this on to also capture specific 4xx codes - useful ones are 429 (rate limited) or 409 (conflict). Noisy codes like 401/403/404/422 are ignored unless you list them. With 404 in the list, browser visits to non-existent pages are logged too (source: page).
admin_error_alerts.codes_4xx_help: Comma-separated HTTP status codes between 400 and 499. Only these 4xx codes are captured.
admin_error_alerts.retention_help: Older entries are pruned daily. Set to 0 to keep them forever.
admin_error_alerts.enabled_help: Master switch for emails. When off, errors are still logged (above) but no email is sent.
admin_error_alerts.http_help: Unhandled 500s plus server-side failures like storage or antivirus being unavailable.
admin_error_alerts.http_4xx_label: Also email about the captured 4xx codes
admin_error_alerts.http_4xx_help: Send an email for the same 4xx codes you capture above (subject to the cooldown and hourly cap).
admin_error_alerts.http_4xx_needs_capture: Turn on "Also record selected client errors (4xx)" above to enable 4xx emails.
admin_error_alerts.cron_note: Failed scheduled tasks are opted in per task on the Scheduled tasks page (the toggle appears there once this feature is enabled).
admin_error_alerts.recipients_admins: All admins (each can mute it under Account → Notifications)
admin_error_alerts.recipients_help: One address per line. These get the email directly and do not appear in the in-app bell.
admin_error_alerts.throttle_help: An identical error is emailed at most once per cooldown window; the next email after the window reports how many repeats were suppressed. The hourly cap is a hard ceiling across all errors.
admin_error_alerts.err_cooldown_range: Cooldown must be between 1 and 1440 minutes.
admin_error_alerts.err_cap_range: Max emails per hour must be between 1 and 1000.
admin_error_alerts.err_custom_empty: Add at least one recipient address, or switch to All admins.
admin_error_alerts.err_4xx_empty: Enter at least one 4xx status code to capture, or turn off 4xx capture.
admin_error_alerts.err_retention_range: Retention must be between 0 and 3650 days.

admin_error_log.intro: Every captured server error (HTTP 5xx), opted-in client error (4xx), and failed scheduled task. Filter by code, status, source, or time; click a row for full detail. "Emailed" marks rows that also triggered an alert.

admin_av.title: Antivirus engine
admin_av.intro: Read-only view of the running ClamAV daemon plus a manual signature reload. The engine auto-checks for new definitions roughly every 12 hours via freshclam.
admin_av.reload_help: Tells the running engine to re-read its signature files from disk. Pick this up after a fresh freshclam fetch lands - no container restart needed.
admin_av.av_skip_notice: Running in AV_SKIP dev mode - no ClamAV engine attached.

auth.logout_not_confirmed: You were signed out on this device, but the server could not be reached - the session may still be active elsewhere. Sign in and out again when you have a connection.
